fusions.name: Split Lunge
fusions.desc: Throws a two-pronged point into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage, then it forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 70% of that damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Two Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Kicks out 2 points that fly apart in diverging directions, each dealing 12 damage and stunning what it hits for 1 second.

fusions.name: Other Branch
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: At Every Crossroads
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you cover, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage. Once every 5 seconds.
